# Actual old announcement

`legacy-announcement.bin` and its declaration are preserved from pre-v2 main
68a273746bfd60abec07397761d8af0184fcd1f0. The current non-canonical corpus
announcement is regenerated by `test/non-canonical/gen` for WireLaw3. Its build
